edges.reason: msg.sender is compared against owner() and treasury to gate the withdraw function.
msg.sender is passed as the mint recipient to _mintToken inside userMint.
msg.sender is validated via _isApprovedOrOwner before burning a token.
treasury state variable is used as an authorized caller of withdraw.
treasury is the recipient of the Ether transfer in withdraw.
withdraw executes the payable transfer of the full balance.
_defaultURI is written into the defaultURI state variable in initialize.
_treasury is written into the treasury state variable in initialize.
_maxMint is written into maxMint in initialize.
_communityMint is written into communityMint in initialize.
_mintPrice is written into mintPrice in initialize.
initialize assigns the treasury state variable.
initialize assigns the mintPrice state variable.
_count participates in tokenIdCounter + communityMint + _count <= maxMint and mintPrice * _count arithmetic.
_count is forwarded to _mintToken as the number of tokens to mint.
_adds supplies the recipient list iterated in airdropTokens.
tokenId selects the token destroyed in burn.
tokenId is used for existence checks and metadata concatenation in tokenURI.
_state is written into isMintEnabled.
_state is written into revealed.
_uri is written into baseURI by the owner.
_isBurnEnabled is written into isBurnEnabled.
_to is the safe-mint recipient in the _mintToken loop.
_tokensCount bounds the incrementing loop over the token counter.
newImplementation is the address whose upgrade is authorized by the onlyOwner hook.
userMint calls the internal _mintToken helper after validations.
userMint reads isMintEnabled to gate minting.
userMint reads maxMint for the total supply bound computation.
userMint reads communityMint in the supply bound computation.
userMint multiplies mintPrice by _count to check msg.value.
userMint reads the token counter to enforce the supply cap.
_mintToken increments the token counter inside an unchecked loop.
_mintToken calls _safeMint, which invokes onERC721Received on the recipient contract mid-mint.
airdropTokens calls _safeMint for each address, invoking an external receiver callback before state is finalized.
airdropTokens decrements communityMint each iteration.
airdropTokens increments and reads the token counter.

normalization_plan.reason: _defaultURI is an input of initialize and is only used to set defaultURI during initialization.
_treasury is an initialize-only input assigned to the treasury state variable.
_maxMint is an initialize-only input assigned to maxMint.
_communityMint is an initialize-only input assigned to communityMint.
_mintPrice is an initialize-only input assigned to mintPrice.
_count is the mint quantity parameter of userMint and drives its supply and payment checks.
_adds is the recipient array parameter consumed only by airdropTokens.
tokenId is the parameter identifying the token destroyed by burn.
tokenId is the parameter used by tokenURI for existence checks and URI construction.
_state is the sole parameter written into isMintEnabled by setMintState.
_state configures the revealed flag set by setReveal.
_uri is the new base URI assigned by setReveal.
_isBurnEnabled is the value written into isBurnEnabled by setBurnState.
_to is the mint recipient used by the _mintToken loop and its _safeMint callback.
_tokensCount is the loop bound of _mintToken controlling how many safe mints occur.
newImplementation is the upgrade target validated by the owner-only _authorizeUpgrade hook.
